headline.zh: 为 AI agent 配置实时检索
headline.en: Configure real-time retrieval for AI agent

scenario.zh: 你正在为客户支持 agent 配置产品文档检索，需要选择最合适的搜索策略
scenario.en: You're configuring product documentation retrieval for a customer support agent

instruction.zh: 决定 agent 如何查找信息
instruction.en: Decide how the agent finds information

output.zh: agent 将根据意图匹配相关内容，适合复杂问题
output.en: Agent matches content by intent, suitable for complex questions

output.zh: agent 将查找包含特定术语的文档，适合政策查询
output.en: Agent finds docs with specific terms, suitable for policy queries

instruction.zh: 选择 agent 检索的内容来源

output.zh: 检索限定在内部知识库，结果权威但覆盖面窄
output.en: Search limited to internal knowledge base, authoritative but narrow

output.zh: 检索扩展到相关行业内容，覆盖更广但需要过滤
output.en: Search extends to industry content, broader coverage but needs filtering

instruction.zh: 查看两种配置返回的示例结果
instruction.en: Review example results from both configurations

label.zh: 配置 A：语义+公司文档

output.zh: 返回 8 篇高度相关的政策文档，包含上下文关联内容
output.en: Returns 8 highly relevant policy docs with contextual connections

label.zh: 配置 B：关键词+行业参考

output.zh: 返回 23 篇精确匹配文档，包含通用行业标准说明
output.en: Returns 23 exact matches including general industry standards

instruction.zh: 选择最终应用的配置方案

output.zh: agent 现在能理解问题意图并返回相关文档摘要
output.en: Agent now understands question intent and returns relevant doc summaries

output.zh: agent 现在精确匹配术语并返回完整政策文本
output.en: Agent now matches terms precisely and returns full policy text

takeaway.zh: Exa 为 AI agent 提供灵活的检索策略，根据场景选择语义或精确匹配
takeaway.en: Exa offers flexible retrieval strategies for AI agents based on scenario needs

initial.zh: 查找关于退款政策和配送时效的最新文档
initial.en: Find latest docs on refund policy and shipping timeframes
